name: DevOps-Gym

evaluation.harbor_aligned_metric: Resolved Rate — Harbor adapter covers all 733 tasks. Parity on 50-task subset: codex+gpt-5-nano original 4.0%±0.89 vs harbor 3.6%±1.17; codex+gpt-5-mini original 22.67%±1.76 vs harbor 22.0%±0.0; openhands+claude-haiku-4-5 original 20.0%±1.15 vs harbor 19.33%±1.76.

results_over_time.note: Paper baselines from Table 1. End-to-end pipeline tasks achieve 0% across all agent-model combinations (no agent completes all 4 stages). Build & Config has 54 tasks (repair + implementation). Monitoring has 34 tasks. Issue Resolving and Test Generation each have 310 tasks (same issues). End-to-end has 18 tasks. Some models score 0% on Monitoring. Gemini-2.5-Pro, DeepSeek-v3.1, and Qwen3-Coder-30B all get 0% on Monitoring.

notes:
DevOps-Gym is the first end-to-end benchmark covering core DevOps workflows. 733 tasks from 30+ Java and Go projects across 5 categories:

1. **Build & Configuration** (66 tasks): Repair (dependency conflicts, misconfiguration, compilation errors, toolchain mismatches, dependency unavailability) and Implementation (migrations, upgrades, plugin integration)
2. **Monitoring** (34 tasks): Resource anomalies (memory leaks, disk leaks, handle exhaustion, CPU spikes) and performance degradation (I/O bottlenecks, inefficient SQL). Agents use CLI tools without source code access.
3. **Issue Resolving** (310 tasks): SWE-Bench style fail-to-pass test transitions on Java/Go repos
4. **Test Generation** (310 tasks): SWT-Bench style test creation on same issues as Issue Resolving
5. **End-to-End** (18 tasks): Sequential 4-stage pipelines (Build → Monitor → Fix → Test). 0% success rate across all models.

Note: adapter_metadata.json lists 733 total (66 build + 34 monitor + 308 codegen + 308 testgen + 17 e2e), slightly different from paper counts (54 + 34 + 310 + 310 + 18 = 726). The adapter may include additional tasks or count differently.

Key findings:
- Best overall: Claude Code + Claude-4-Sonnet (51.85% build, 20.56% monitoring, 23.87% issue resolving, 13.87% test gen)
- Monitoring is extremely hard: 0% for Gemini-2.5-Pro, DeepSeek-v3.1, and Qwen3-Coder-30B
- Language bias: Claude-3.5-Sonnet drops from 70.4% on SWE-Bench-Verified (Python) to 23.87% on DevOps-Gym (Java/Go)
- End-to-end: 0% across all agents — no agent can chain all 4 DevOps stages
- Framework matters: Claude Code >> OpenHands >> mini-SWE-Agent with same model
- Published at ICLR 2026

Harbor adapter covers all 733 tasks with parity on 50-task subset (~6.8% sampling). Oracle achieves 100% across all 5 categories.
